title: A single archaeon couples long-chain fatty acid oxidation to methanogenesis
title_zh: 单一古菌将长链脂肪酸氧化与产甲烷作用耦合
abstract: Anaerobic degradation of complex organic compounds to methane and carbon dioxide is common in the deep subsurface biosphere and has long been considered to require syntrophic cooperation, with methanogens confined to the terminal use of simple C1 and C2 substrates. Thermodynamic considerations, multi-omics analyses and microcosm experiments suggest that archaeal lineages are capable of methanogenic degradation of complex substrates1–6. However, experimental validation in pure culture was lacking. Here we report the isolation of a thermophilic archaeon, Methanoglobus dolicholipophagus AA-75, affiliated with Archaeoglobi, from a Chinese petroleum reservoir. Strain AA-75 not only converts methanol into methane, carbon dioxide and acetate, but also uses saturated fatty acids varying from C7:0 to C18:0 and unsaturated fatty acids including C16:1, C18:1 and C18:2 to produce methane. We term the latter lipotrophic methanogenesis, which integrates β-oxidation of fatty acids with the Wood–Ljungdahl pathway and the canonical methyl-tetrahydromethanopterin:coenzyme M methyltransferase and methyl-coenzyme M reductase complexes, together with an intracellular electron transfer system. A formaldehyde-methanol branch probably functions as an auxiliary route for C1 metabolism during methanogenesis. Methane produced from stearate is moderately 13C-enriched (δ13C–CH4 = −40.0‰ to −36.3‰), distinct from the strong 13C depletion characteristic of canonical methanogenic pathways. These findings demonstrate that methanogens can function as primary degraders of complex organic matter, challenging the classical syntrophic paradigm and calling for refinement of current models of carbon cycling in the deep subsurface biosphere. Methanoglobus dolicholipophagus AA-75 is a thermophilic archaeon isolated from a Chinese petroleum reservoir that converts methanol into methane, carbon dioxide and acetate, and uses saturated and unsaturated fatty acids to produce methane.
abstract_zh: 将复杂有机化合物厌氧降解为甲烷和二氧化碳的现象在深部地下生物圈中普遍存在，长期以来被认为需要共生合作，产甲烷菌被局限于使用简单的C1和C2底物进行终末代谢。热力学考量、多组学分析和微域实验表明，古菌谱系能够降解复杂底物进行产甲烷作用1–6。然而，纯培养中的实验验证一直缺乏。在此，我们报道从中国石油储层中分离出一种嗜热古菌Methanoglobus dolicholipophagus AA-75，其隶属于考古球菌。AA-75株不仅将甲醇转化为甲烷、二氧化碳和乙酸盐，还利用C7:0至C18:0的饱和脂肪酸以及包括C16:1、C18:1和C18:2在内的不饱和脂肪酸产生甲烷。我们将后者称为脂类依赖型产甲烷作用，它将脂肪酸β-氧化与Wood–Ljungdahl途径及规范的甲基-四氢甲酰肟：辅酶甲基转移酶和甲基-辅酶甲基还原酶复合物，以及一种细胞内电子转移系统相结合。甲醛-甲醇支路可能在产甲烷过程中作为C1代谢的辅助途径。由硬脂酸产生的甲烷呈中度13C富集（δ13C–CH4 = −40.0‰至−36.3‰），与规范产甲烷途径特征的强13C耗竭明显不同。这些发现表明产甲烷菌能够作为复杂有机物的初级降解者，挑战了经典的共生范式，并呼吁改进当前关于深部地下生物圈碳循环的模型。Methanoglobus dolicholipophagus AA-75是一种从中国石油储层中分离出的嗜热古菌，能将甲醇转化为甲烷、二氧化碳和乙酸盐，并利用饱和和不饱和脂肪酸产生甲烷。
